fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2025-01-12 states that the complainant paid Rs. 2,50,000 to a person who promised a job placement, but no appointment order was provided and calls went unanswered, on 2025-01-10 around 09:15 hrs. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100069. The complaint refers to Sanjay Mani, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000120. Tamilarasan Velan (9000000281) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Dinesh Subramani, using the number 9000000212. The complainant mentioned a bank transaction reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly paid a fee for a job that was never provided.
fields.Keywords: job fraud, cheating, suspect, mobile number, morning, receiving account, bank reference, shopping complex
